description: This file defines the Mutator class which manages state changes, server interactions, and undo/redo functionality for a web application, specifically handling operations related to boards, blocks, views, and user interactions in a project management or kanban-style app.

classes.name: Mutator
classes.description: A class that manages all server state changes, undo/redo operations, and interactions with the server API for boards, blocks, views, and user actions.
